Recorded in this Universität Hamburg batch because UHH's own Medical Faculty is an explicit, named co-awarding partner, not a mere cross-reference; none of language_of_instruction, duration or campus were inferred - all are stated verbatim on that page's own fact box.
researcher_notes: Listed inside Universität Hamburg's own official programme catalogue table (Fakultät column: MED) but the table's own href points directly to a haw-hamburg.de page, not a uni-hamburg.de detail page, because this is a genuine joint dual-degree programme between HAW Hamburg and Universität Hamburg's Medical Faculty (UKE) - confirmed on the HAW Hamburg page itself, which names both partner institutions explicitly and states the academic degree (B.Sc.) is combined with professional midwifery licensure. official_program_url and admissions_url both point to the HAW Hamburg page because Universität Hamburg's own catalogue does not host a separate detail page for this programme - that HAW page is the only official page describing it.
